name: Winnipeg Jets Hockey Club
notes: Revenue, operating income (EBITDA) and player expenses are Forbes estimates for 2024-25 (USD, net of revenue sharing and arena debt service); valuation is Forbes enterprise value calculated December 2025 (Forbes: owner True North Sports + Entertainment, purchased 2011 for $170M, shown on the page as '$170M'). Founded: since the Sept 24, 2026 consolidation the Jets' official history includes the original Jets (entered the NHL in 1979) and the Atlanta Thrashers (1999-2011); the current franchise relocated to Winnipeg in 2011 (first game Oct 9, 2011). NHL records now give firstSeasonId 19791980. Chipman's and Thomson's percentages are not stated on any citable page read. The 2011 Thrashers purchase predates the 2015 deal window and has no deal row. Arena capacity: True North's 2001-era plan was a '15,000-seat arena' and a 2006 AHL game drew a 'capacity crowd of 15,015'; the current hockey capacity was not found on canadalifecentre.ca, so stadium_capacity is null. Missing: capacity, stakes, social, attendance, sponsors, honours (none).
